enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed for the duration. Turn over occasionally. Adjust the pillow with hands. Pull the blanket up. Continue lying on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet hands. Pick up the soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands under the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Wipe face with a towel. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom. Walk to the bedroom. Open the closet. Take out work clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Put on the shoes.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place bread on the counter. Pick up the toaster. Plug in the toaster. Place bread slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Wait for the toast. Pick up the toasted bread. Place the bread on the plate. Pour milk into a cup. Pick up the cup. Drink the milk. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Pick up the plate. Place the plate in the sink. Rinse the plate.

Walk to the door. Open the door. Walk out of the house. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the pocket. Walk to the car. Open the car door. Sit in the driver's seat. Close the car door. Fasten the seat belt. Insert the key into the ignition. Start the car. Hold the steering wheel. Press the pedal. Drive along the street. Stop at the traffic light. Press the pedal again. Drive forward. Turn the steering wheel. Pull into the hospital parking lot. Park the car. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the car door. Step out of the car. Close the car door. Walk toward the hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk through the hospital entrance. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the uniform. Put on the uniform. Put on the gloves. Pick up the stethoscope. Walk to the first patient's bed. Pick up the medical chart. Read the chart. Check the patient's blood pressure with the cuff. Write the reading on the chart. Check the patient's pulse. Reposition the patient in the bed. Adjust the IV drip. Walk to the next patient. Take the patient's temperature. Record the temperature. Pick up the medicine tray. Hand the medicine to the patient. Hand a cup of water to the patient. Walk to the storage room. Open the cabinet. Take out supplies. Restock the shelves. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down at the computer. Type patient records. Press the mouse. Stand up. Answer the phone. Speak to a colleague: 'Please check bed three.' Walk back to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Open the staff room door. Walk to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down on the chair. Open the lunch bag. Take out the food container. Open the container lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Drink water from the bottle. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Close the container lid. Place the container into the lunch bag. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk to the sink. Rinse the bottle. Walk to the door. Open the door. Walk out of the staff room. Walk back to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, continuing patient care and record keeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the patient beds. Check the patients' conditions. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Measure blood pressure. Write the reading on the chart. Adjust the IV line. Replace a dressing by hand. Dispose of the used gloves. Put on new gloves. Answer the call bell. Walk to the patient. Turn the patient on the bed. Adjust the pillow. Hand the patient a glass of water. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down. Pick up the pen. Write patient notes. Type on the computer keyboard. Press the mouse. Print the documents. Pick up the printed pages. File the pages into the folder. Answer the phone. Speak to a colleague: 'I will handle the next round.' Stand up. Walk back to the ward.

Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take off the uniform. Put on the jacket. Close the locker. Walk to the hospital exit. Walk to the parking lot. Open the car door. Sit in the driver's seat. Close the car door. Fasten the seat belt. Insert the key into the ignition. Start the car. Hold the steering wheel. Press the pedal. Drive out of the parking lot. Stop at the junction. Drive forward. Turn the steering wheel. Drive along the street. Pull into the driveway. Park the car. Turn off the engine. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the car door. Step out of the car. Close the car door. Lock the car. Walk to the front door. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker switch on. Pour oil into the pan. Put the meat into the pan. Stir the food with a spatula. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Press the induction cooker switch off. Pick up a plate. Place the food on the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate. Place the plate in the dishwasher.

Walk into the living room. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the phone. Tap the phone screen. Put the phone down. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up.

Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Open the shower door. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step under the water. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub shampoo on the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower door. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check emails and news
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Press the computer power button. Move the mouse. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the email application. Click on unread emails with the mouse. Read the email text. Click the reply button. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click the send button. Open the browser. Type the news website address. Press the enter key. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Click on an article. Read the article. Close the browser window. Press the computer power button to shut down. Stand up. Push the chair in.

Walk into the bedroom. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Sit on the bed. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Press the volume button. Lie down on the bed. Put the remote on the nightstand. Pull the blanket over the legs. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Put the remote on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging phone and devices ahead of Saturday's planned community outage
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the phone. Pick up the charging cable. Plug the cable into the phone. Plug the other end into the wall outlet. Place the phone on the nightstand. Pick up the computer. Pick up the computer charger. Plug the charger into the computer. Plug the charger into the wall outlet. Place the computer on the desk. Pick up the desk lamp. Press the desk lamp switch on to check it works. Press the desk lamp switch off. Unplug the desk lamp. Plug the desk lamp into the power bank. Check the charge indicator light. Place the power bank on the desk.

Turn off the bedroom light. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the body. Adjust the pillow with hands. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over onto the side. Pull the blanket up again. Continue lying on the bed.
